hints.title: Core Idea
hints.text: Consider the highest bit that is set in the starting integer n.

hints.title: Highest Bit Invariant
hints.text: All integers between the largest power of two less than or equal to n and n itself have that highest bit set to 1.

hints.title: Clearing the Bit
hints.text: To clear this highest bit via cumulative bitwise and, the sequence must extend down to include the integer one less than that power of two.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: Bit length arithmetic in constant time.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Sequential bitwise and simulation takes O(n) operations, which times out for large integers.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Identify that the most significant bit dictates the boundary at 2^b - 1.
